classification.difficultyReason: Translate each bearing into a sketch, choosing its quadrant and converting true bearings to an angle from north or south where needed.

content.prompt: Sketch the bearing and then label the distance and show the angle made with North or South.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Toni walked 5 km at a bearing of $210^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$.

answer.short: $\mathrm{S}30^{\circ}\mathrm{W}$; label the southwest ray 5 km and the angle from South $30^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: $210^{\circ}-180^{\circ}=30^{\circ}$. Draw the ray $30^{\circ}$ west of South and label it 5 km.

spec.description: Compass axes with North up, a southwest ray labelled 5 km, and a 30 degree sector from South toward West. Source blue answer marks use ordinary black house geometry.
spec.mathematics: Bearing 210 degrees gives direction S30W; endpoint direction is (sin 210 degrees, cos 210 degrees).
spec.answerVisibility: Completed sketch appears only with answers.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Ben rode 15 km at a bearing of $320^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$.

answer.short: $\mathrm{N}40^{\circ}\mathrm{W}$; label the northwest ray 15 km and the angle from North $40^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: $360^{\circ}-320^{\circ}=40^{\circ}$. Draw the ray $40^{\circ}$ west of North and label it 15 km.

spec.description: Compass axes with North up, a northwest ray labelled 15 km, and a 40 degree sector from North toward West. Ordinary geometry is black.
spec.mathematics: Bearing 320 degrees gives direction N40W; the ray has TikZ direction 130 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Completed sketch appears only with answers.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Roy drove 46 km at a bearing of $055^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$.

answer.short: $\mathrm{N}55^{\circ}\mathrm{E}$; label the northeast ray 46 km and the angle from North $55^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: Draw the ray $55^{\circ}$ east of North and label it 46 km.

spec.description: Compass axes with North up, a northeast ray labelled 46 km, and a 55 degree sector clockwise from North. Ordinary geometry is black.
spec.mathematics: Bearing 055 degrees gives direction N55E; the ray has TikZ direction 35 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Completed sketch appears only with answers.
